verdict.rationale: Probes found no llms.txt (404) and no markdown docs endpoint (404), so there is no static agent-oriented docs surface to point an agent at. Terraform's official MCP server does give AI models real-time access to current provider documentation, modules and policies from the registry, which serves part of the agent-docs need through a different channel. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, markdown/agent-readable versions of the core docs, and evidence that the MCP server covers Terraform's own CLI and language documentation.
